description_en: Retrieves a list of service versions
name: ListServiceVersions

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 100. The number of returned results may be less than the specified value but never exceeds it
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to provide this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, obtain the token from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies that results are returned starting from the first version that is sorted by version number after startKey (inclusive)
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从startKey之后（包括startKey）按版本号排序的第一个开始返回
parameters.name: start_key

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction of the returned versions. Valid values:

FORWARD: Sorts versions in ascending order.
BACKWARD: Sorts versions in descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
限定返回的版本排序方向：
FORWARD：从小到大排序。
BACKWARD：默认值，从大到小排序
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The start date of the function invocation, in the format of EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the Function Compute invocation request
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id

schema.description_en: The response body returned for querying versions
schema.description_zh: 查询版本返回的响应体

direction.description_en:
The sort direction of the returned versions. Valid values:

FORWARD: Sorts versions in ascending order.
BACKWARD: Sorts versions in descending order. This is the default value
direction.description_zh:
限定返回的版本排序方向：
FORWARD：从小到大排序。
BACKWARD：默认值，从大到小排序

nextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to provide this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, obtain the token from the previous response
nextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取

createdTime.description_en: The time when the service version was created

description.description_en: The description of the service version

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the service version was last updated
lastModifiedTime.description_zh: 服务的版本上一次被更新的时间

versionId.description_en: The version number of the service
